title: Senior FastAPI Developer
description: We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own the services behind our hiring and candidate platform. You will design REST APIs in FastAPI, model data in PostgreSQL, and ship them to AWS ECS through an automated pipeline. This is a hands-on role with real ownership of design decisions.
responsibilities:
Design and build FastAPI services and their Pydantic contracts.
Model relational data and write reviewed Alembic migrations.
Keep p95 latency and error budgets under control.
Review pull requests and mentor two mid-level engineers.
Participate in a light, business-hours on-call rotation.
skills: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, PostgreSQL, Alembic, Docker, AWS ECS, pytest, REST API design

title: React Frontend Engineer
description: Join the frontend team building the candidate-facing careers portal and the internal recruiter console. You will work in React and TypeScript with a strong emphasis on accessibility, responsive layout and honest loading and error states.
responsibilities:
Build typed, reusable React components against documented API contracts.
Own responsive behaviour from 375px to widescreen.
Write component tests with Vitest and Testing Library.
Work with design on an accessible component library.
Keep bundle size and Core Web Vitals in budget.
skills: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, Tailwind CSS, Vitest, accessibility (WCAG AA), REST integration

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Own the path from a merged pull request to a running service. You will maintain our GitHub Actions pipelines, the Terraform that defines every AWS resource, and the observability that tells us when something is wrong before a customer does.
responsibilities:
Maintain Terraform for VPC, ECS, RDS, S3 and CloudFront.
Harden GitHub Actions pipelines and OIDC-based AWS access.
Own CloudWatch dashboards, log retention and alarms.
Drive cost reviews and right-sizing.
Write runbooks the whole team can follow.
skills: Terraform, AWS (ECS, ECR, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM), Docker, GitHub Actions, CloudWatch, Linux, Bash

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Help us run a small, well-understood AWS footprint properly. You will work on networking, least-privilege IAM and the guardrails that keep a development account from turning into a surprise invoice.
responsibilities:
Design VPC layouts, subnets, routing and security groups.
Write least-privilege IAM policies and review existing ones.
Automate environment creation and teardown with Terraform.
Investigate and fix cost anomalies.
Document architecture decisions for the wider team.
skills: AWS VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS Fargate, RDS, Terraform, CloudWatch, cost optimisation, Python or Go scripting

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn hiring, funnel and product data into decisions leadership can act on. You will own recurring reporting and dig into the questions behind the numbers rather than just producing charts.
responsibilities:
Build and maintain recruiting and funnel dashboards.
Write well-structured SQL against PostgreSQL.
Define and document metrics so everyone reads them the same way.
Run ad-hoc analyses for hiring and operations.
Present findings to non-technical stakeholders.
skills: SQL, PostgreSQL, Python (pandas), data visualisation, statistics, dashboarding, stakeholder communication

title: Product Designer
description: Design the end-to-end experience of applying for a job and of reviewing candidates. Both journeys deserve the same care: a nervous applicant on a phone and a recruiter working through fifty applications on a Monday morning.
responsibilities:
Own end-to-end flows from research through to shipped UI.
Maintain the design system alongside the frontend team.
Run usability sessions with real candidates and recruiters.
Design accessible, responsive layouts and specify states.
Pair with engineers during implementation.
skills: Figma, interaction design, design systems, accessibility, prototyping, user research, responsive layout

title: HR Executive
description: Be the first human a candidate speaks to. You will run scheduling and screening for a growing engineering and sales team, and keep our hiring pipeline honest, quick and respectful.
responsibilities:
Screen applications and run first-round conversations.
Coordinate interview panels and schedules.
Keep candidate records and statuses accurate and current.
Drive offer roll-out and onboarding paperwork.
Report weekly on pipeline health.
skills: Recruitment coordination, candidate screening, ATS tools, scheduling, communication, HR documentation

title: Sales Manager
description: Lead a small, high-intent B2B sales team selling to mid-market companies in India. You will own the number, the pipeline discipline behind it, and the development of three account executives.
responsibilities:
Own quarterly revenue targets and the pipeline that supports them.
Coach and review a team of three account executives.
Run a disciplined CRM and forecasting practice.
Partner with marketing on qualified lead flow.
Close strategic accounts personally.
skills: B2B SaaS sales, pipeline management, CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), forecasting, negotiation, team leadership

title: Finance Executive
description: Keep the company's books accurate and its compliance calendar boring. You will handle month-end close, vendor payments and statutory filings, working closely with the founders on runway reporting.
responsibilities:
Run month-end close and prepare management reports.
Manage accounts payable, receivable and reconciliations.
Handle GST and TDS filings with our consultants.
Maintain the fixed-asset and expense registers.
Support annual audit and due diligence requests.
skills: Accounting, Tally or Zoho Books, GST, TDS, reconciliations, Excel, financial reporting

title: Customer Support Specialist
description: Be the person customers are relieved to reach. You will answer questions across email and chat, reproduce bugs properly before escalating, and turn recurring confusion into better documentation.
responsibilities:
Answer customer questions over email and live chat.
Reproduce and document issues before escalating to engineering.
Maintain help-centre articles and canned responses.
Track recurring themes and report them to product.
Meet agreed response and resolution targets.
skills: Written communication, troubleshooting, ticketing tools (Zendesk/Freshdesk), empathy, documentation

title: Marketing Specialist
description: Own top-of-funnel demand generation for a technical product sold to technical buyers. You will run content, email and paid experiments, and you will be measured on qualified pipeline rather than impressions.
responsibilities:
Plan and run content and email campaigns end to end.
Manage paid experiments and report on cost per qualified lead.
Own SEO for the product and careers sites.
Work with sales on lead quality feedback loops.
Maintain the marketing analytics stack.
skills: Content marketing, SEO, email automation, paid acquisition, analytics (GA4), copywriting, B2B positioning

title: Operations Associate
description: Make the day-to-day machinery of the company run without drama: vendors, facilities, internal tooling and the small processes everyone depends on and nobody owns.
responsibilities:
Manage vendors, contracts and renewals.
Own office and remote-team logistics.
Administer internal SaaS tooling and access.
Document and improve internal processes.
Support finance with purchase and expense workflows.
skills: Operations, vendor management, process documentation, spreadsheets, coordination, SaaS administration

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: A six-month, paid, mentored internship on a real production codebase. You will ship small features to the careers portal with a senior engineer reviewing every pull request, and you will learn how code actually reaches AWS.
responsibilities:
Ship small, well-tested features under mentorship.
Write unit tests for the code you contribute.
Participate in code review, standups and retrospectives.
Learn the Docker, CI and AWS deployment path end to end.
Present your work at the end of the internship.
skills: Python or JavaScript fundamentals, Git, SQL basics, willingness to learn, clear written communication

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: A twelve-month contract to build the automated regression suite for our web application and APIs, and to wire it into the CI pipeline so that it actually blocks bad releases.
responsibilities:
Build end-to-end and API regression suites.
Integrate the suites into GitHub Actions.
Triage failures and keep the suite trustworthy.
Define test data strategy and environment resets.
Report coverage and quality trends each sprint.
skills: Playwright or Cypress, pytest, REST API testing, CI/CD, Docker, test design, defect triage

title: Technical Recruiter (Part Time)
description: A part-time role (around twenty hours a week) sourcing engineering candidates. This posting is currently closed and is kept here so the admin console has an inactive job to demonstrate.
responsibilities:
Source and engage engineering candidates.
Run structured screening conversations.
Keep the pipeline and status data accurate.
Advise hiring managers on market realities.
Report weekly on sourcing funnel health.
skills: Technical sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, screening, stakeholder management
